`mnist-digits.json` contains the first example of each digit from the MNIST test set,
28×28 unsigned grayscale bytes encoded as base64. Source: the PyTorch MNIST mirror
at https://ossci-datasets.s3.amazonaws.com/mnist/t10k-images-idx3-ubyte.gz and its
matching labels. The underlying NIST handwriting images are public domain.

These ten images exercise the packaged inference pipeline. They do not establish
accuracy on tournament sheets or independent writers; real scanned sheets remain
a required field trial.
